units.text: INT. GHOSTS - CONTINUOUS
What the devil do you mean? Do you set yourself up against your father, you hussy?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Mutters without looking at him.
You've said often enough I was no concern of yours.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Pooh! Why should you bother about that--
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Haven't you many a time sworn at me and called me a--? Fi donc !
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Curse me, now, if ever I used such an ugly word.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Oh, I remember very well what word you used.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Well, but that was only when I was a bit on, don't you know? Temptations are manifold in this world, Regina.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Ugh!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: And besides, it was when your mother was that aggravating--I had to find something to twit her with, my child. She was always setting up for a fine lady.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Mimics.
"Let me go, Engstrand; let me be. Remember I was three years in Chamberlain Alving's family at Rosenvold."
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Laughs.
Mercy on us! She could never forget that the Captain was made a Chamberlain while she was in service here.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Poor mother! you very soon tormented her into her grave.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: With a twist of his shoulders.
Oh, of course! I'm to have the blame for everything.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Turns away; half aloud.
Ugh--! And that leg too!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: What do you say, my child?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Pied de mouton .
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Is that English, eh?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Yes.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Ay, ay; you've picked up some learning out here; and that may come in useful now, Regina.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: After a short silence.
What do you want with me in town?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Can you ask what a father wants with his only child? A'n't I a lonely, forlorn widower?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Oh, don't try on any nonsense like that with me! Why do you want me?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Well, let me tell you, I've been thinking of setting up in a new line of business.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Contemptuously.
You've tried that often enough, and much good you've done with it.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Yes, but this time you shall see, Regina! Devil take me--
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Stamps.
Stop your swearing!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Hush, hush; you're right enough there, my girl. What I wanted to say was just this--I've laid by a very tidy pile from this Orphanage job.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Have you? That's a good thing for you.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: What can a man spend his ha'pence on here in this country hole?
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Well, what then?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Why, you see, I thought of putting the money into some paying speculation. I thought of a sort of a sailor's tavern--
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Pah!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: A regular high-class affair, of course; not any sort of pig-sty for common sailors. No! damn it! it would be for captains and mates, and--and--regular swells, you know.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: And I was to--?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: You were to help, to be sure. Only for the look of the thing, you understand. Devil a bit of hard work shall you have, my girl. You shall do exactly what you like.
units.name: ENGSTRAND

units.text: Oh, indeed!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: But there must be a petticoat in the house; that's as clear as daylight. For I want to have it a bit lively like in the evenings, with singing and dancing, and so on. You must remember they're weary wanderers on the ocean of life.
units.name: ENGSTRAND
